scripts.build: vite build && tsc --noEmit && esbuild server/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=dist-server/index.js && esbuild server/setup.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=dist-server/setup.js && esbuild server/config.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=dist-server/config.js && esbuild server/desktop.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=dist-server/desktop.js
scripts.package:mac: pnpm build && pnpm build:native && node scripts/package-desktop.mjs mac && node scripts/package-dmg.mjs
scripts.package:windows: pnpm build && pnpm build:windows && node scripts/package-desktop.mjs windows
